test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL - General Awareness (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: In January 2021, which state/Union Territory issued its ‘School Bag Policy 2020’, according to which the weight of the school bag should be at a maximum of 3.5 kgs to 5 kgs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• School Bag Policy 2020: **The government of Delhi** has issued guidelines to reduce the weight of school bags for the students in primary, secondary as well as senior secondary levels, according to news agency ANI.
 
• According to the new guidelines, the weight of the school bag should be at a maximum of **3.5 kgs to 5 kgs. **
 
• The guidelines have been issued under the School Bag Policy 2020, which had been drawn by experts from **NCERT, CBSE, Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), and Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS).**
 
• It was released by the **Union Ministry of Education and NCERT** in November previous year and shared with the Education Secretaries of **all the states too the Union Territories.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​** **The State of Karnataka has recently limited a load of school bags in May 2019**.
 
• The National Education Policy (NEP) of 2020 **provides an important opportunity to move Indian education from “sorting and selection” to “human development,” enabling every student to develop to their maximum potential**.
 
• NEP 2020 aims to **increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education including vocational education from 26.3% (2018) to 50% by 2035**.
 
• ** 3.5 Crore new seats will be added to Higher education institutions.**
